reason: council-remediation-2026-07-20 agent-R: original question cited Rule VIII Sec. 808 window free areas, which is off-scope for an article limited to PD 1096 Rule I (General Provisions, Sec. 101-106). Replaced with a Rule I Sec. 105 site-requirements question that the article directly supports.

source_audit_support.citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule I, Section 105

proposed.text: Per IRR Sec. 105, every site or building intended for human habitation must be kept at a safe distance from which three categories of hazards, as determined by competent authorities?

options.text: High-voltage transmission lines, airports, and military installations
Polluted streams or bodies of water or air sources, a volcano or volcanic site, and any other building considered a potential source of fire or explosion
Heavy industrial zones, agricultural pesticide spray zones, and active fault lines
Solid waste landfills, cemeteries, and slaughterhouses

proposed.rationale: Section 105 requires the site for human habitation to be at a safe distance from: polluted streams, bodies of water, or air sources; a volcano or volcanic site; and any other building considered a potential source of fire or explosion. The exact clearance is set by the competent authority, but Section 105 supplies the minimum safety concept.
proposed.explanation: Section 105 supplies the framework for site-safety questions; the exact technical clearance may come from a hazard map, local ordinance, or competent authority.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule I, Section 105
